title: Hiram Bingham reaches Machu Picchu
summary: Guided by local farmers, American explorer Hiram Bingham reached the ruins of the Inca citadel of Machu Picchu high in the Peruvian Andes.
reason: Bingham was searching for Vilcabamba, the last refuge of the Inca, and relied on local knowledge of ruins in the area.
significance: It brought Machu Picchu to world attention, and it became a symbol of Inca civilization.
